summary:
## Retrospective

The issue was resolved through a standard triage-code-review-fix cycle. The nil pointer bug was caught during review and fixed promptly.

proposals.title: Add nil-safety linter rule
proposals.what_happened: A nil pointer dereference reached the PR stage without being caught by static analysis.
proposals.what_could_go_better: This class of bug should be caught earlier in the development cycle.
proposals.proposed_change: Enable the nilaway linter in the CI pipeline to catch nil pointer issues at build time.
proposals.validation_criteria: The linter runs in CI and would have flagged the original bug in main.go:42.
